name: Glock (main hand)
notes: With a shield or other off hand: 2 rounds per left-click cycle (two shots). Shield needs STR 10 (class base is 4).
pairing: Grants marker buff hwp_glock_main; the off-hand Glock reads it.
primary: Alone or with a shield/offhand: one accurate round per shot. With an off-hand Glock: alternates left/right muzzles.
secondary: From the off-hand item (shield bash, etc.)
